# Shutap

> Shutap turns a personal story — a family comment that landed wrong, a partner who took someone else's side, a manager who made it weird, a friend who keeps doing the thing — into a set of joke cards, each taking a different comedic angle on the same situation, the way a comedian works one bad night into a routine. Pseudonymous. Identifying details are stripped before storage. Shutap makes jokes about situations, never about the person telling the story, and it does not give advice.

Shutap is an entertainment web application, not a healthcare, mental-health, crisis, or legal service. Members keep a consistent pseudonym across sets, which is what lets the Mirror read back what keeps coming back. 18+.

The brand line is "SHUTAP. Joke about it." The tagline is "life's a bitch. so make fun of it."

## Core

- [What Shutap is](https://shutap.com/about): You have the material. Shutap does the writing part — jokes about the situation, never about you.
- [How it works](https://shutap.com/how-it-works): You type what happened, Shutap writes the set, you flip the cards and keep the ones that land.
- [Lived Intelligence](https://shutap.com/lived-intelligence): The practical knowledge earned by living through real situations — and the material a set is written from.
- [Trust & privacy](https://shutap.com/trust): Pseudonymity model, identifying details stripped before storage, what is and isn't indexed, takedown path.

## Pillars

- [Relationships](https://shutap.com/relationships): Dating, partners, situationships, breakups, the gray area in between.
- [Marriage](https://shutap.com/marriage): The long-haul stuff — roommate energy, resentment, repair, leaving, staying.
- [Family](https://shutap.com/family): Parents, siblings, in-laws, the dinner comment, the guilt.
- [Career](https://shutap.com/career): Work, money, managers, burnout, the job everyone tells you to be grateful for.

## Legal & policies

- [FAQ](https://shutap.com/faq): Common questions — is it therapy (no), is it pseudonymous (yes), how is my data handled.
- [Terms of Service](https://shutap.com/terms): The rules of the room; 18+; not a medical or legal service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://shutap.com/privacy): Pseudonymous by design, identifying details stripped before storage, no sale of data, full access/export/delete rights.
- [House rules](https://shutap.com/guidelines): The joke goes at the situation, not at a person.
- [If it's heavy](https://shutap.com/safety): Crisis resources (988, Samaritans, findahelpline) and how Shutap stops joking and routes to real help.
- [AI Disclosure](https://shutap.com/ai-disclosure): The cards are written by AI — not a person. It gets things wrong and cannot give medical, mental-health, or legal advice.
- [Legal hub](https://shutap.com/legal): Index of all policy pages.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://shutap.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable pages.
